title: Restricted cohomology arrow identity and composition
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$, with inverse-image coefficient transitions $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume the canonical inverse-image identity and composition equations for $\varphi$. Fix a scheme $X$, an index $i_0\in I$, a morphism $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, and an open $W\subseteq X$. Put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$ and $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$. For $f:j\to k$ in $J$, restrict $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})$ to $W_k\to W_j$. The coefficient map is the inverse-image composition comparison across this commuting restriction square followed by restriction of $\varphi_f$. For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $T_W^n(f)$ be cohomology pullback along this restricted scheme map followed by cohomology of the coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Then $T_W^n(\mathrm{id}_j)=\mathrm{id}$ for every $j\in J$, and $T_W^n(f\mathbin{;}g)=T_W^n(f)\mathbin{;}T_W^n(g)$ for every pair $f:j\to k$, $g:k\to l$. No cone or cocone data is required.

proof.text: Cancel the stage-open inclusions to prove identity and reversed composition of restricted scheme maps. Substitute hidentity and cancel the inverse-image left and right unit comparisons. For composites substitute hcomposition. Naturality moves the coefficient transition past the second square comparison, and vertical pasting identifies the comparisons with the composite square. Cohomology identity, pullback composition, coefficient naturality and H.map composition give the stated equalities. Empty opens and zero coefficients require no extra assumptions.

theorem tailOpenCohomologyArrow_laws
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, tailOpenCohomologyArrow D g₀ W F φ n (𝟙 j) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (j k l : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k) (g : k ⟶ l),
      tailOpenCohomologyArrow D g₀ W F φ n (f ≫ g) =
        tailOpenCohomologyArrow D g₀ W F φ n f ≫
          tailOpenCohomologyArrow D g₀ W F φ n g)
